//: WHAT THIS SCREEN SAYS IN ITS OWN WORDS. Nothing that came out of the journal is here: an invoice's number, date, SKU, description and amounts are shown exactly as the provider recorded them. The store's name and its motto are not here either -- they are the institution's own voice and live in Textos.cs, where a translator does not see them. {clave} is a hole the code fills.

noEncontrado.cuerpo: There is nothing at this address.

misFacturas.bajada: your purchases, on your own computer.

fallo.operacion: The operation could not be completed.
fallo.apertura: The app could not be opened.

permiso.explicacion: Your folder is “{carpeta}”. The browser asks you to confirm write permission every time you reopen the app.

carpeta.explicacion: This app keeps your invoices in a folder of yours. Choose the folder and the app writes its record there; nobody else reads it.
carpeta.sinSoporte: This browser has no showDirectoryPicker, so it cannot write to a folder of yours. The app still works, but the record lives in memory only and is lost when you close it.

sinCarpeta.cuerpo: This app is running without a folder: what you see is asked of the provider again every time you open it, and no record of yours is left on disk.
sinCarpeta.pie: Without a folder: the record lives in memory only and is lost when you close it.

guardadoFallando.cuerpo: What you see on screen is not saved in “{carpeta}”. It is usually the permission, which expires when you reopen.

misFacturas.vacio: There are no invoices yet. Press Refresh.

detalle.sinAbrir: The app is not open. Go back to the list to open it.
detalle.noExiste: There is no invoice numbered “{numero}” in your record.
